checks: Full-dimensional original sampled fibers have finitely many possible clipped vertices defined by independent fixed normals and affine offsets. Their feasibility and incidence changes are cut out by affine conditions; fixed face lattices permit pulling triangulations with fixed oriented determinants. Null original fibers contribute zero everywhere.

Finite moving slabs give continuity of G even at chamber boundaries. At a single threshold interval with a nonconstant tail, some positive fiber has a proper section off projected vertex levels; its positive area supplies S_i>0. Unit continuous normal gives the coarea factor one, including interval sections.

The finitely many exceptional tail levels include constant branch values and projected vertices. The analytic algebraic inverses obey t_i'=1/S_i and t_i''=−S_i'/S_i^3. An affine wall restricted to one analytic algebraic branch either vanishes identically or has finitely many zeros, by canceling the value variable from an annihilating polynomial.

The chain rule applies to the chamber polynomial restricted to the path and is independent of the polynomial choice on a persistent face. Without coincident moving facets the partial derivative is exposed area bounded by the original section area.

The old proper anchor gives positive finite right slope and analytic t_i(a)=b_i+κ_i a+O(a²). Any vertex persisting as a approaches zero is O(a) from its limit in the core. The opposite bound comes from a small Minkowski combination of a relative core ball and an original interior ball, and compactness excludes empty core fibers near zero. Right analyticity identifies the leading coefficient and exponent d−q_0.
Read 92c5cf1d847ad56c §§4–5, (9)–(11). The adopted scope is the polytopal variant of the same actual rightmost path and uses only the right limit at the zero core.

dependencies.hypotheses: The frozen predecessor supplies actual compact fibers and the common rightmost quantile path, proper old anchors and zero-volume core. This draft adds the ambient polytope hypothesis. Independent approval of that exact predecessor is required before admission.

overlap.comparison: Its finite fan realizes compatible support tangents. This claim concerns offset clipping, algebraic threshold inversion and mixed core asymptotics.

readability: S_i' is the derivative in the cap threshold, not in the distal parameter. The derivative expression on a persistent face is understood by composition with any adjacent polynomial.
review_method: Independent proof read of the exact frozen candidate and check of its sources and predecessors. Exact rational replay for the distal and two-triangle numerical certificates.
summary: Finite clipped-polytope chambers, algebraic quantile inversion, and a two-sided tube bound prove the derivative formulas and exact creation exponent.
